'''Jayke Ball SYCFA Manipulator v 1''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11154">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11154 SYCFA Manipulator v 1], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 15 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11154/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11154/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022110731/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11154/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 15 October 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''SYCFA Manipulator v 1''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 SMV1 Ball DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits CS Docking Bay: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' This deck uses the SYCFA objective as a mock so you can manipulate like crazy

== Original post ==

'''SYCFA Manipulator v 1'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' October 15, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck uses the SYCFA objective as a mock so you can manipulate like crazy

=== Strategy ===

Basically get myoom onith out fast and use her to kill off all unigue Males. Then use Monnok to kill of doubles. YOu have good SAC in this deck so don't worry.  Use your Big charactors to beatdown whoever they manage to get out. Then spread out and force drain to finish them off. It is an easy deck to set up and wins alot. Your effects to start out with are up to you, I ussually go with Imperial Arrest Order, CHYBC, and Mobization Points. Have fun with this one.
